offers_products.reason: Alight Worklife SaaS platform and LumenAI engine are core offerings alongside administration services.

offers_services.reason: Benefits administration outsourcing, absence management, healthcare navigation and advisory delivered for employers; larger part of business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Clients are employers who buy; employees use the service but the employer chooses and contracts.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells benefits administration and Worklife platform to employers, majority of Fortune 100 and many Fortune 500.

recurring_revenue.reason: Multi-year benefits administration outsourcing contracts and platform subscriptions generate ongoing recurring fees from employers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Benefits administration for payroll-linked employee benefits is essential and contract-based, not easily cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Ongoing administration and platform fees under long contracts, not large infrequent one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue relies mainly on the Worklife platform, automation and AI technology, though call-center staff also contribute.

large_customers.reason: Partners with majority of Fortune 100 and many Fortune 500 companies; targets scale and complexity.

asset_heavy.reason: Technology and service business needing software development and staff, not plants, fleets or property networks.

notes: Mix of technology platform and outsourced administration services; people_delivered is borderline.
